_comment: The auth-boundary string contract (identity slice E-7, design P3). These strings appear VERBATIM in the SQL that raises them (migration 0027 — the latest defining migration; authContract.test.ts greps it, and verify-0027 §E pins them against live pg_proc.prosrc so a future CREATE OR REPLACE can't drift silently). The client matcher imports THIS file; never retype a string on either side. The verify runner injects these via psql -v.

joinClassErrors.notStudent: Only student accounts can join a class
joinClassErrors.badCode: No class found for that code
joinClassErrors.domainTemplate: This class is limited to % accounts

signupRefusalTemplate: Email % is not permitted to sign up
_transportNote: signupRefusalTemplate never reaches the browser — GoTrue swallows trigger raise text and redirects with a generic server_error (T1 ruling). The client keys the sign-in-failed screens on error PRESENCE, not this phrase. joinClassErrors DO reach the client verbatim via PostgREST rpc error messages.
